pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions exhibiting sharp edge angularity and high-contrast pixel gradients. The patches are non-uniform in spatial area, becoming more elongated and larger on the shoulder compared to the upper neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways forming a topological mesh. Junction nodes primarily consist of tri-radial intersections with a relatively uniform pixel thickness across the visible mid-section.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated contour along the dorsal ridge, characterized by dense, short-cropped hair tufts projecting against the soft-focus background.
